column2: You can choose from: 2-room Flexi 3-room Standard flat These flats come with shorter leases, making them more affordable than 99-year lease flats. You can select a lease length between 45 and 65 years, which must last until you and your spouse reach 95 years old.
You may apply for the loan, subject to credit assessment.
Your resale levy will be capped at $30,000. This amount will be reduced based your chosen lease length under Fresh Start.

If you are a first-timer family applicant, you can receive the Enhanced CPF Housing Grant (EHG) of up to $120,000. If you are a second-timer family applicant, you can receive the Fresh Start Housing Grant (FSHG) in 2 parts: An upfront grant disbursed shortly before key collection A deferred grant disbursed over 5 years after key collection The FSHG amount depends on application timing as follows: Application Timing Upfront Grant Before Key Collection Deferred Grant Over 5 Years Total Grant Amount Before July 2025 $35,000 Up to $15,000 $50,000 From July 2025 $60,000 Up to $15,000 $75,000
You may receive priority for up to 10% of 2-room Flexi and 3-room BTO/ SBF flats under the Tenants’ Priority Scheme (TPS) .
